# Employment Contract

This Employment Contract is made between Contoso Cloud Ltd. ("the Company")
and the Employee for the role of Senior Platform Engineer.

1. Place of Work. Your working arrangement is Hybrid — three days per week in
   the London office and two days remotely.
2. Compensation. Your base salary is £95,000 per year, paid monthly in arrears,
   less statutory deductions.
3. Hours of Work. Your normal working hours are 37.5 hours per week, Monday to
   Friday.
4. Notice. Either party may terminate this agreement on four weeks' written
   notice.
